annotations.title: Estimate tempo, delay times and bar lengths

description: Tempo arithmetic for editing to music: pass tap timestamps (ms) to estimate BPM with a stability and confidence rating, or pass a known bpm. Either way it returns the beat length, a delay table (straight, dotted and triplet ms for each note value) and how many seconds a number of bars lasts in a time signature. It works on numbers you supply and does not analyse audio. Errors when neither input is given, the taps do not yield a tempo, bpm is outside 30-300, or the time signature is not one listed.

bars.description: Number of bars to convert into seconds. Default 16.

bpm.description: Known tempo in beats per minute. Used instead of the tap estimate when both are given.

timeSignature.description: Time signature for the bar length. Default 4/4.

timestampsMs.description: Tap times in ms from a monotonic clock (performance.now()), in order.
